audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Skill, Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Skill while Ziggs wins 60% here and the already-audited mirror set all seven rows to Ziggs on both layers.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 450 range against Ziggs' 850 Q; Lillia has no gap-closer at all, and her one swing tool is a 150s ultimate.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Ziggs as one atomic group across both layers, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stage whys handed levels 4 through first item to Lillia and carried no cooldowns.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 at 1600 range — surviving it once removes her only power window for two minutes.
audit.corrected: phases[2..4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and whys[3..6] rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Several mechanical errors: 'Blooming Blast' is not an ability (it is Blooming Blows); Swirlseed is called an 'E dash' when it is a rolling seed that slows and stops at walls; the movement speed is credited to Watch Out! Eep! when Riot's text puts it on Blooming Blows; and spikes[2] claims she 'heals through chip' when nothing in her kit heals.
audit.why: The dash claim is the dangerous one — a Ziggs player saving Satchel for a dash that does not exist has no answer for the seed that actually cuts his retreat, and he has no dash of his own.
audit.corrected: Real name restored, Swirlseed described as the 700-range rolling slow that stops at walls, the speed stacking moved to Blooming Blows, the heal claim removed, and Blooming Blows' true damage on the edge stated.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Lillia can't read the angle.
edits.after: Swirlseed rolls 700 until it hits a wall and slows — you have no dash, so hold Satchel for that cut-off, not for poke.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Lillia below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track Blooming Blows before every step-up.
edits.after: Chip her below 60% while Lullaby is offline — her Q reaches 450 to your 850, so she cannot answer a disciplined step-up.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and reaches 1600 — survive it once and her only swing tool is gone for two minutes.

edits.before: Track Lillia’s Blooming Blows: Her kiting speed stacks — catch her early in the chase or not at all. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Blooming Blows stacks her move speed and its edge deals true damage at 450 — and Swirlseed cuts your retreat, so hold Satchel for that.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kiting speed stacks — catch her early in the chase or not at all. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Satchel for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Lillia Lilting Lullaby: 150s at rank 1 at 1600 range — her one swing tool, so bait or dodge it and the lane stays yours. - Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and stacks her speed. - Budget W Satchel for emergencies and R for opportunities.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still out-space her pre-ultimate.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you out-space her 450-range Q entirely.

edits.before: Her level 6 R Lilting Lullaby sleeps you and swings the lane to her.
edits.after: Level 6 Lullaby is 150s and 1600 range — dodge it and you still lead.

edits.before: First-item Liandry's plus passive burn lets her out-sustain your poke.
edits.after: First item your Torch chip beats her stack-reliant short-range kit.

edits.before: Late game her AoE sleep and mobility overwhelm your artillery.
edits.after: Late your artillery and R zoning outrange her 1600 sleep setup.

edits.before: Early you outrange Lillia hard: her Q Blooming Blast is short and her only real threat is stacking passive burn, so poke her off the wave with Bouncing Bomb before she can build stacks and drop E to deny her slow-dance walk-up.
edits.after: Early you outrange Lillia hard: her Q Blooming Blows reaches only 450 and its edge deals true damage, so poke her off the wave with Bouncing Bomb before she stacks passive burn and drop E to deny the walk-up.

edits.before: Lillia's R Lilting Lullaby flips the lane: it puts your whole side to sleep and follow-up burst wakes you for bonus damage, so respect her all-in windows and hold W Satchel to reposition the instant she E-dashes in.
edits.after: Lillia's R Lilting Lullaby flips fights: it sleeps your side at 1600 range on 150s and the follow-up wakes you for bonus damage, so dodge it and hold W Satchel for the moment her Swirlseed lands.

edits.before: Once Lillia has Liandry's plus Riftmaker her passive burn and R combo out-sustain your poke; she kites your skillshots with W speed and heals through chip while chunking you with movement-speed Q hits.
edits.after: Once Lillia has Liandry's her passive burn chips your max health, but her Q still reaches only 450 — hold the 850 gap, and note Blooming Blows' edge damage is true, so MR alone will not cover a bad step-up.

edits.before: Hold W Satchel to escape her E dash and R sleep setup
edits.after: Hold W Satchel to escape her Swirlseed and Lullaby setup

edits.before: Kite your skillshots with W Watch Out! movement speed
edits.after: Kite your skillshots with stacked Blooming Blows speed
